notes.title: Announcement Trailer is Live
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to share the very first [b]Announcement Trailer[/b] for [i]Rollout Rally[/i]! It’s a physics-based marble racing party game where chaos meets strategy and marbles do their best to survive wild, obstacle-filled tracks.[/p][p]What makes it different?[/p][list][*][p]Before each race, you pick a [b]power-up card[/b] that changes how your marble behaves.[/p][/*][*][p]Then, you let gravity and physics do their thing no direct control, just pure chaos.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer? Yup. Twitch integration? In progress. Strategy? Absolutely.[/p][/*][/list][p]This trailer sets the tone for what we’re building: a game that’s fun to play [i]and[/i] fun to watch — whether you're racing or just cheering your marble on.[/p][p]We’ll be participating in the upcoming [b]Racing Fest[/b] on Steam and you’ll be able to play an [b]early demo[/b] for the first time during the event![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_ZeHR1bfcEU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
And if it looks like your kind of fun, hit that [b]Wishlist[/b] button it really helps us out![/p][p]Thanks for being part of the ride![/p][p][/p][p]The Rollout Rally Dev Team[/p]
